integrations.name: Desmos Graphing Calculator
integrations.description: Interactive 2D and 3D graphing, function manipulation, curve analysis, parameter sliders, and geometry constructions. Add your own Desmos API key in the Settings and Integration Hub before enabling.

integrations.name: Accounting Journal and Ledger Sheets
integrations.description: Interactive spreadsheets for general journal entries, T-accounts, trial balances, and financial statements with live debit and credit balancing, formula auto-sum, and cell-by-cell verification.

integrations.name: GeoGebra Dynamic Math
integrations.description: Dynamic geometry, 3D coordinate graphing, vector fields, and algebraic constructions.

integrations.name: 3Dmol.js Molecular Visualizer
integrations.description: Interactive 3D molecular structures, PDB and SDF macromolecule viewing, rotating proteins, and chemical bond representations.

integrations.name: In-Browser Code Sandbox
integrations.description: In-browser code editor with syntax highlighting, unit-test execution, and output verification for JavaScript and Python.
